application_decisions.statement: Allocate the approved closed VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE source package to internal position selector 1.
Keep selector 1 noncanonical and do not represent it as a canonical OPI slot ID or label.
Count this application as exactly one occupied OPI position and one slot consumed structurally.
Do not author or validate an OPI item in this allocation application gate.
Do not unlock QA/STR003-STR005, generalize KE or alter lexical authority.
If approved, open only a separate position-1 OPI authoring strategy gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Positional allocation is structural curriculum occupancy, not OPI authoring or OPI validation.
No canonical OPI slot ID or label is created by allocating internal selector 1.
No subject/person, tense/aspect or copula semantics are introduced or inferred.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this first-position allocation application while this gate remains active.
